seeds.text: Tell me about a time you were proud of something nobody else noticed.
followUpHints: What exactly did you do?
Why did it matter to you that no one saw it?

seeds.text: Tell me about a time you changed your mind about something that mattered. What moved you?
followUpHints: What did you believe before?
What was the moment it shifted?

seeds.text: Think back to a decision you made before you were twenty that you still think about. What happened?
followUpHints: What did you actually do?
What did it teach you?

seeds.text: Was there a moment that split your life into a before and an after? Tell me about it.
followUpHints: What changed in how you act, day to day?
Who else was part of it?

seeds.text: Tell me about a time you failed at something that mattered to you. What did you do in the days after?
followUpHints: Who did you tell, and who didn't you?
What did you take from it?

seeds.text: Tell me about someone who believed in you before you believed in yourself. What did they do?
followUpHints: What did they actually say or do?
How did it change what you did next?

seeds.text: Tell me about a time you stood up for someone else. What was at stake?
followUpHints: What did you risk?
Would you do it the same way again?

seeds.text: Tell me about something or someone you walked away from. Why then?
followUpHints: What was the last straw?
What did you feel the day after?

seeds.text: Tell me about a time you made something from nothing - a project, a group, a habit, a repair. How did it start?
followUpHints: What was the first concrete step you took?
What kept you going?

seeds.text: Tell me about a time a stranger or near-stranger was unexpectedly kind to you. What happened?
followUpHints: What did they do exactly?
Did it change how you treat people?

seeds.text: Tell me about a time you were scared and did the thing anyway.
followUpHints: What were you actually afraid of?
What got you to move?

seeds.text: Is there a lesson life seems to keep teaching you? Tell me about the time it landed hardest.
followUpHints: When did you first notice the pattern?
Have you actually learned it yet?
